what: Free local retouch of v2 (no model call): the clock showed 4:00 in a June-morning scene (ambience 'ranne mesto', morning light). The white dial disc inside the brass frame (centre master px 2229, 456.5 = game 1560, 321; radius 41 game px, 3 master px soft edge) was mirrored about the minute hand, so the symmetric ticks stay and the hands read 8:00. Frame, column and everything else identical to v2.
